data.name: Numan
data.gender_notes: Numan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Numan represents utmost honor and excellence, drawing from its Arabic origin. The name Numan carries the meaning “Blood, Red” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Numan usually hope their child will grow to embody blood, red and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In a Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is said to have praised a companion named Numan, indicating the virtues of this name in Islamic culture.
data.etymology: Numan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blood, Red.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Numan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نعمان
in_arabic.meaning: نعمان هو اسم يعني بالعربية الزيادة والنمو
in_arabic.long_meaning: نعمان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'نَعِمَ' الذي يعني الزيادة والنمو. ورد ذكر اسم نعمان في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران، الآية 144، وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات الأصول النبوية. يرمز الاسم إلى الازدهار والنماء، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نعمان
in_urdu.meaning: نعمان کا مطلب ہے وادھا اور ترقی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نعمان ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وادھا اور ترقی۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة آل عمران، آیت 144 میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور حدیث نبوی شریف میں بھی اس کا ذکر ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے اور اس کا تعلق نبوی سلسلے سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नुमान
in_hindi.meaning: नुमान का अर्थ है वृद्धि और प्रगति
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुमान एक पुराना और महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है वृद्धि और प्रगति। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आल इमरान, आयत 144 में उल्लेखित है, और पैगंबर मुहम्मद के वंश से जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और इसका अर्थ है समृद्धि और विकास।

in_pashto.name: نعمان
in_pashto.meaning: نعمان د ډیریدو او وده معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نعمان یو مهم نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د ډیریدو او وده معنی لري. دا نوم د قران کریم په سورت آل عمران، آیت 144 کې یادونه شوی دی، او د پیغمبر محمد صلی الله علیه وسلم د کورنۍ سره تړاو لري. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري او د برکت او موفقيت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Numan
in_english.meaning: Means increase, growth, and prosperity in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Numan is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning increase, growth, and prosperity. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'n-ʿ-m' which connotes the idea of growth and abundance. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al Imran, verse 144, and is associated with the prophetic tradition. The name symbolizes flourishing and advancement, and is cherished in Islamic culture for its noble connotations and historical significance.

data.cultural_impact: Numan is a name that has a strong cultural significance in the Middle Eastern region and is frequently used among the Arabic population. Its origins come from the Arabic word "numū" which translates to "red" or "blood," signifying the boldness and fervor associated with the name. Numan is an intense and powerful name that is appealing to those who value courage and determination in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Numan is a name that carries spiritual significance, reflecting the strength and unwavering faith that comes from embracing one's identity. It represents the inner courage that propels individuals to stand up for their beliefs, inspiring them to be resilient in the face of adversity. Additionally, the connection to the color red is believed to represent the blood of the Prophets, reminding those with the name Numan of their spiritual lineage and connection to their religious heritage.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Blood, Red" symbolizes Numan represents utmost honor and excellence, drawing from its Arabic origin.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Numan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of blood, red.

historical_references.reference: Numan Ibn Mundhir Al-Numayri (d. 602 CE) was a powerful Arab chieftain and one of the earliest converts to Islam.
historical_references.context: Noman was a leader of the Banu Hanifah tribe in the Hejaz region of Arabia. He is considered to be one of the first converts to Islam and is known for his military prowess and leadership during the early Islamic conquests.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Numan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
